mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Sport P440e engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rebuilt AJ300 3.0-litre Ingenium I6 engine for the Range Rover Sport P440e typically costs £7,500-£9,500 supply-only, with fitting adding approximately £1,000-£1,500 at a specialist. Dealer prices can reach £12,000-£18,000 for a full replacement. Used AJ300 engines cost £2,800-£4,500, reconditioned units £5,500-£8,000, and rebuilt with 12-month warranty £7,500-£9,500.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of BECM failure in a Range Rover Sport P440e?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Battery Energy Control Module (BECM) is a known weak point on P440e models. Common symptoms include: 'Hybrid System Fault' warning on the dashboard, vehicle refuses to charge or charging stops prematurely, car won't enter 'Ready' mode or start, red battery warning light, and zero electric range - vehicle runs on petrol only.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Sport P440e?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - a 2022-2024 Range Rover Sport P440e typically holds £55,000-£90,000 of value. Even a full engine replacement at £7,500-£9,500 represents a small fraction of the vehicle's worth. For older examples approaching £40,000-£50,000, the replacement still makes financial sense if the rest of the vehicle is in good condition.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Sport P440e engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full Range Rover Sport P440e engine replacement typically takes 5-10 working days. Engine removal and installation takes 2-3 days, hybrid system re-calibration and testing takes 1-2 days, with total turnaround 5-10 days depending on parts availability.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the P440e and P510e engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are 3.0-litre Ingenium I6 PHEV engines in the L461 Range Rover Sport. The P440e produces 440PS (434bhp) combined output, while the P510e produces 503bhp combined output - a higher tune of the same engine. Both use the same AJ300 engine block and 105kW electric motor, with the P510e having higher boost and revised ECU mapping.

mainEntity.name: Does the Range Rover Sport P440e have timing chain problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing chain tensioner wear has been reported on Ingenium petrol engines, including the AJ300 in the P440e. Symptoms include rattling noise on cold start, rough running, and reduced performance. Preventative replacement at 60,000-80,000 miles is recommended, costing £1,800-£3,000 at a specialist. Ignoring it can lead to catastrophic engine failure.

historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover Sport P440e - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Range Rover Sport P440e debuted with the third-generation L461 model in 2022, marking Land Rover's commitment to electrified performance in its sportiest SUV. Unlike earlier Sport models powered by diesel V6s or supercharged V8s, the P440e combines a 3.0-litre straight-six Ingenium petrol engine with a plug-in hybrid system - a powertrain configuration unique to this generation.

milestones.description: AJ300 Ingenium I6 3.0-litre turbocharged petrol PHEV launched with the all-new L461 Range Rover Sport. Total system output: 440PS (434bhp) with a 105kW electric motor and 38.2kWh battery.
2024 - P440e continues as a core PHEV offering across SE, Dynamic SE and Autobiography trim levels. Electric-only range of approximately 70 miles (113km).
2026 - Minor software updates to hybrid management system; battery and electric motor specifications remain unchanged through the L461 generation.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Sport P440e Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover Sport P440e uses the AJ300 3.0-litre Ingenium I6 petrol engine paired with a 105kW electric motor and 38.2kWh battery. While the Ingenium petrol six-cylinder is more reliable than its diesel siblings, PHEV-specific components introduce additional failure points. Rebuilt AJ300 engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing the original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: BECM Failure - Why the Range Rover Sport P440e Loses Hybrid Function
problems.rootCause: The Battery Energy Control Module (BECM) controls the high-voltage battery charging process and hybrid system operation. Internal electronic failure prevents the vehicle from charging, entering 'Ready' mode, or using electric drive.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Diagnose and replace BECM unit, reprogramme hybrid system
repairOptions.longevity: If caught early before battery damage occurs

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt 3.0-litre Ingenium I6 with warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If engine damage has occurred alongside BECM failure

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Apply this UK-wide decision framework: - Vehicle worth under ~£5,000: repair or used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit. - Vehicle worth ~£5,000-£8,000: evaluate both; reconditioned is viable if keeping the car 2+ years. - Vehicle worth ~£8,000-£15,000: reconditioned/rebuilt usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability. - Vehicle worth £15,000+: replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value.
problems.recommendation: If your P440e displays a 'Hybrid System Fault' warning or refuses to charge, have the BECM diagnosed before assuming engine replacement is needed. BECM replacement is significantly cheaper than a full engine swap. However, if the engine has suffered timing chain failure or internal damage from running without hybrid assistance, a rebuilt AJ300 unit with upgraded components and 12-month warranty is the sensible long-term solution.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt AJ300 Range Rover Sport P440e engine prices

problems.h4: Timing Chain Tensioner Wear - Why the Range Rover Sport P440e AJ300 Rattles on Start-up
problems.rootCause: Ingenium petrol engines use timing chains rather than belts. Chain tensioner wear can cause the chain to slacken, leading to a rattling noise on cold start, rough running, and in severe cases, catastrophic engine failure if the chain jumps or breaks.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace timing chain, tensioners, guides; inspect for collateral damage
repairOptions.longevity: If caught early before valve/piston damage

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt 3.0-litre Ingenium I6 with upgraded tensioners
repairOptions.longevity: If chain has jumped causing valve/piston damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A 2022-2024 Range Rover Sport P440e typically holds £55,000-£90,000 of value, so even full engine replacement is financially viable. However, timing chain replacement alone is usually sufficient if diagnosed promptly - don't assume the worst until a specialist has inspected the engine.
problems.recommendation: Address any rattling noise from the engine bay immediately. Early timing chain replacement (£1,800-£3,000 at a specialist) is far cheaper than a full engine rebuild (£7,500-£9,500) if the chain fails catastrophically. Use a JLR specialist familiar with Ingenium engines - they'll know the specific tensioner revisions and can fit upgraded parts.
